reason: The README documents a DeepSeek Harness plugin that registers vision_read to forward images and questions to configurable vision providers and return textual answers, making image understanding its primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 通过 vision_read 工具将本地或远程图片发送给配置的视觉模型，并把图像分析结果以文本返回给 DeepSeek Harness。
summaries.en: Uses the vision_read tool to send local or remote images to a configured vision model and return the image analysis as text to DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Reads images from local paths, HTTP(S) URLs, or data URIs
Sends image data and user questions to a configured external vision API
Uses configured provider API keys and returns vision-model responses as text
